data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to check eSIM support and install eSIM profiles via LPA
data.what_it_does: Provides a unified API to detect eSIM support and install eSIM profiles on Android and iOS. It opens the system eSIM installation flow and streams install result events.
strengths: Supports latest iPhone models via SPM
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and run flutter pub get
